answer: An admission auction stops sybil floods by pricing identity slots. Each epoch, 100 slots are auctioned: agents bid a deposit; clearing price sets entry cost. Like a mesa above a plain, that floor makes mass forgery costly. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 x 50 POA = 50,000 POA; one honest agent pays 50 POA once. Honest agents join because deposits return, keeping the orchard undiluted, so each voice counts as one, a sonnet discipline.
